summary: Independent review of Jinshu chapter 080 units s0200–s0221 for Wang Xizhi’s death notice, Xie Wan’s undated defeat tag, the Ningzhi–Sun En Kuaiji sequence, Xuanzhi’s early death, and Huizhi’s two Huan-staff posts. The chapter itself gives no reign year for 年五十九卒 or for 玄之早卒; those rows correctly stay undated and do not convert fifty-nine sui into a birth year. Posthumous 金紫光祿大夫 and the sons’ refusal stay retrospective and do not feed life dates. 萬不能用，果敗 is Xie Wan’s own defeat and converts, as a conventional Eastern Jin 穆帝升平三年 label, to AD 359. 孫恩之攻會稽 and 遂為孫所害 convert, as 安帝隆安三年十一月 events that remain inside AD 399 on a proleptic Gregorian new-moon table, to AD 399. Huan Wen’s 大司馬 tenure as his own office is supported as AD 363–373 from 哀帝興寧元年 to 孝武帝寧康元年. Huan Chong’s 車騎 identification is supported as bounds on or after AD 375 and on or before AD 384, preserving the 桓沖傳 寧康三年 車騎 reading against the 孝武帝紀 太元元年 車騎 appointment and the 太元九年 death while still 車騎. The defect is Wang Huizhi’s 為大司馬桓溫參軍: the chapter only places that staff post under a man already titled 大司馬. The rows copy Wen’s full tenure as a westernInterval and the hint “AD 363–373 adviser,” which states activity throughout those years rather than uncertainty about Huizhi’s own undated appointment. The parallel 車騎桓沖 post already uses bounds; the Wen post must do the same.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xizhi's death is attested at fifty-nine sui with no calendar year in this chapter.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p061 Wang Xizhi. s0202 states 年五十九卒 and nothing else that could yield a reign year, month, or Western endpoint. The undatedSourceAttestation correctly refuses to invent a death year or to back-calculate a birth year from inclusive sui.

evidence.quote: 年五十九卒，贈金紫光祿大夫。

itemChecks.event: Wang Ningzhi is named as Xizhi's son and given Jiangzhou, Left General, and Kuaiji offices with no year.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p071 Wang Ningzhi. s0204 names 子 凝之 and s0207 lists 江州刺史、左將軍、會稽內史 without a reign year. Leaving the career list as an undated attestation is required; the 399 Kuaiji fighting is dated on other owned rows and must not be back-filled onto the earlier undated offices.

evidence.quote: 仕歷江州刺史、左將軍、會稽內史。

itemChecks.event: Wang Ningzhi is in office at Kuaiji when Sun En attacks the commandery.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p071. The chapter dates the episode only as 孫恩之攻會稽. Jinshu 安帝紀 places 孫恩陷會稽 and 內史王凝之死之 in 晉安帝隆安三年十一月甲寅. The Ministry of Education year-number index gives 隆安 as AD 397–401, so year 3 is the conventional AD 399 label. Liu's proleptic Gregorian new-moon table puts 隆安三年十一月朔 on 12-14 with 癸丑, so 甲寅 is 12-15 and remains inside AD 399; a Julian-default converter would shift the day, not the Western year. Year-level AD 399 is therefore the supported conventional conversion, not a month-day Gregorian event date.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xuanzhi is attested only by the undated notice that he died young.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p072 Wang Xuanzhi. s0206 says only 玄之早卒. No reign year, age in sui, or Western bound is present, so the undated attestation is the entire supported chronology.

itemChecks.event: Sun En attacks Kuaiji in the episode that kills Wang Ningzhi.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p073 Sun En. The named attack is his own act in s0209/s0211. The same 晉安帝隆安三年十一月 identification used for claim-473 yields conventional AD 399 and does not cross the following Western year.

itemChecks.event: Wang Huizhi served as army adviser to Grand Marshal Huan Wen.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p074 Wang Huizhi. s0214 says 為大司馬桓溫參軍: Huizhi held a staff post under a man already titled 大司馬. That title belongs to Huan Wen from 晉哀帝興寧元年 (conventional AD 363) until Wen's death in 晉孝武帝寧康元年 (conventional AD 373). Those years bound when the appointment could fall; they are not Huizhi's own start and end of service. westernInterval 363–373 therefore invents a second endpoint and describes activity throughout Wen's marshal years. The adjacent 車騎桓沖 post in s0215 is already encoded as westernBounds. Huizhi's Wen post must use onOrAfter 363 and onOrBefore 373, not a closed tenure interval.

itemChecks.event: Wang Huizhi later served as cavalry adviser to Huan Chong while Chong was titled 車騎.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p074. s0215 says 又為車騎桓沖騎兵參軍, so the post is Huizhi's own and is dated only by Chong's 車騎 title. Jinshu 桓沖傳 places 車騎將軍 at 甯康三年 (conventional AD 375). The 孝武帝紀 instead makes 中軍將軍桓沖為車騎將軍 in 太元元年 (conventional AD 376) after recording a 寧康三年 move to 鎮北將軍、徐州刺史. He dies still 車騎將軍 in 太元九年二月 (conventional AD 384). westernBounds onOrAfter 375 and onOrBefore 384 preserve both title-start readings and do not invent an exact year for Huizhi's undated staff post. Certainty uncertain is warranted.

evidence.quote: 又為車騎桓沖騎兵參軍

itemChecks.event: Huan Wen holds the title Grand Marshal used to identify him in Huizhi's staff notice.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p075 Huan Wen. The chapter only writes 大司馬桓溫. 晉哀帝紀 興寧元年五月 adds 大司馬; 孝武帝紀 寧康元年七月 still lists 大司馬 at 桓溫薨. 興寧 is Aidi's era AD 363–365 and 寧康 is Xiaowudi's era AD 373–375 on the Ministry year-number index, so the conventional tenure label is AD 363–373. That interval is Wen's own office, not a dynasty-long activity window and not Huizhi's service span.

itemChecks.event: Huan Chong holds the title General of Chariot and Cavalry used to identify him in Huizhi's second staff notice.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p076 Huan Chong. The chapter only writes 車騎桓沖. The 375 biography reading, the 376 annalistic appointment, and the 384 death as 車騎 are competing or bounding facts about Chong's own title. westernBounds onOrAfter 375 and onOrBefore 384 keep that uncertainty and do not pick a winning start year. 太元 here is 晉孝武帝太元 (AD 376–396), not Wu 太元.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xuanzhi died young, with no calendar year supplied.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p072. 早卒 is an explicit death manner without age, month, or reign year. Omitting westernYear is required; a guessed birth or death year would be fabrication.

itemChecks.event: Wang Huizhi held the office of army adviser to Grand Marshal Huan Wen.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p074. The office 大司馬參軍 is explicit in s0214, but its dateContext copies Huan Wen's 363–373 marshal tenure as a westernInterval. Huizhi's holding of the post is one undated event inside that tenure, not service from 363 through 373. Replace the interval with westernBounds onOrAfter 363 and onOrBefore 373; do not alter the office label.

itemChecks.event: Wang Huizhi held the office of cavalry adviser on Huan Chong's staff.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p074. s0215 states 車騎桓沖騎兵參軍. The dateContext uses the same supported 375–384 bounds as claim-477 for Chong's 車騎 title and does not claim Huizhi occupied the post for that entire span.

itemChecks.event: Huan Wen held the office of Grand Marshal from his 興寧元年 appointment until his 寧康元年 death.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p075. The chapter's 大司馬桓溫 is his title. The 363–373 interval is the conventional year label of that tenure, justified by the 哀帝紀 appointment and the 孝武帝紀 death notice, not by reading activity into every month of those civil years.

itemChecks.event: Huan Chong held the title General of Chariot and Cavalry at the time Huizhi served on his staff.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p076. 車騎 is Chong's own title in s0215. Bounds onOrAfter 375 and onOrBefore 384 keep the 寧康三年 versus 太元元年 start conflict and the 太元九年 death as 車騎, instead of forcing a false exact tenure.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xizhi's age at death is given as fifty-nine sui.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p061. 年五十九卒 is an explicit traditional age at death. Reckoning remains sui; no birth year is derived.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xizhi died at the stated age of fifty-nine sui, with no calendar year in this chapter.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p061. The death is his own event. s0202 supplies age and 卒 but no reign year. Keeping the row undated, and refusing later reconstructed death years, matches the source. The following posthumous gift is a separate reception and is not used here as a life date.

evidence.quote: 年五十九卒，贈金紫光祿大夫。

itemChecks.event: Wang Xizhi was posthumously offered the title Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p061 as recipient. 贈金紫光祿大夫 follows 卒 in the same sentence, so receptionType retrospective is required. The honor is undated; it is not living activity and supplies no death year.

itemChecks.event: After Wang Xizhi's death, the offered posthumous honor was firmly declined by his sons acting on his prior wishes.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p061 as the named recipient of the declined honor. s0203 is later reception of the death-and-gift sequence, not Xizhi's living activity. retrospective is the correct later-reception class; no calendar year is present, and none is invented.

evidence.quote: 諸子遵父先旨，固讓不受。

itemChecks.event: Xie Wan ignored Wang Xizhi's advice and was defeated on the northern campaign that followed his Yuzhou command.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p066 Xie Wan. s0201 萬不能用，果敗 is his own defeat, immediately after the chapter's 萬後為豫州都督 letter. 晉穆帝紀 升平三年冬十月 records 謝萬次下蔡…王師敗績. 升平 is Mudi AD 357–361 on the Ministry index, so year 3 is the conventional AD 359 label. The annal is month 10, which does not cross into the next Western year. The chapter phrase carries no year of its own; AD 359 is that identified campaign, not a guessed month-day Gregorian date.

itemChecks.event: Wang Ningzhi refused to prepare defenses when Sun En attacked Kuaiji.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p071. s0210 凝之不從 and s0211 既不設備 are his own acts inside the 孫恩之攻會稽 episode. The AD 399 conversion is the same supported 隆安三年 November identification as claim-473.

itemChecks.event: Wang Ningzhi was killed by Sun En at Kuaiji.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p071. 遂為孫所害 is Ningzhi's own death, not a later commemoration. 安帝紀 隆安三年十一月甲寅 records 內史王凝之死之 in the same Kuaiji fall. Conventional AD 399 is the year of that death; later Sun En campaigns are other events.

itemChecks.event: Sun En attacked Kuaiji and killed Wang Ningzhi.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p073. The attack and killing are Sun En's own acts in s0209 and s0211. The supported conversion remains AD 399 from 隆安三年十一月.

itemChecks.event: Wang Ningzhi was killed at Kuaiji during Sun En's attack.
itemChecks.reason: The hint restates Ningzhi's own supported AD 399 death, not a later reception or an office held throughout a dynasty. It matches claim-564 and does not smuggle the death year into an earlier undated career list.

itemChecks.event: The empty hint list records that Xuanzhi has no sourced personal activity date.
itemChecks.reason: s0206 gives only 早卒. An empty active-date-hint array is required; filling a birth or death year would invent chronology the chapter does not have.

itemChecks.event: Sun En attacked Kuaiji in the episode dated AD 399.
itemChecks.reason: The hint is Sun En's own attack, aligned with claim-475 and claim-565, and does not use a later campaign or death as a life date.

itemChecks.event: Wang Huizhi served as adviser to Huan Wen and later as cavalry adviser to Huan Chong.
itemChecks.reason: The second string correctly restates the supported Chong bounds. The first string, “AD 363-373 adviser to Huan Wen,” treats Huizhi's undated 大司馬參軍 post as activity throughout Wen's marshal years. That is the same interval error as claim-476 and claim-510. Rewrite the first hint to on or after AD 363 and on or before AD 373 for that staff post.

evidence.quote: 又為車騎桓沖騎兵參軍

itemChecks.event: Huan Wen held the Grand Marshal title during the years used to identify him in this chapter.
itemChecks.reason: The hint names Wen's own 大司馬 tenure, AD 363–373, which is supported for claim-478 and claim-515. It is not an active hint drawn from a posthumous reception.

itemChecks.event: Huan Chong was General of Chariot and Cavalry with Wang Huizhi on his staff.
itemChecks.reason: The hint uses the same supported on-or-after 375 / on-or-before 384 bounds as claim-479 and claim-517 for Chong's own 車騎 title, preserving the 375/376 start conflict.

personChecks.reason: Wang Ningzhi's owned rows plus the chapter list him as Xizhi's son, give undated Jiangzhou / Left General / Kuaiji offices, show Five-Pecks devotion, and then date only the Kuaiji defense and death. No birth or age appears in s0200–s0221. AD 399 is his own death and the attack he failed to meet, not a later commemoration. The empty date on the earlier office list is coherent with that later event; nothing requires a life-year from the 399 death beyond the event itself.

evidence.quote: 次凝之，亦工草隸，仕歷江州刺史、左將軍、會稽內史。

personChecks.reason: Wang Xuanzhi appears only as 玄之早卒. Among all supplied items he has an undated died-young death and an empty hint list. No twin is inferred, no sui figure is present, and no competing witness offers a year. That is complete for this chapter segment.

Sun En's owned chronology in these units is the Kuaiji attack that kills Ningzhi. AD 399 is that attack, not a later 隆安四年 or 五年 raid and not his own later death, which this segment does not narrate. The hint matches the dated event.

Wang Huizhi's chapter block names him, gives the courtesy name, then records two staff posts and undated anecdotes through s0221. No birth, age, or death falls inside the owned units; the later death notice is outside this job. The Chong cavalry post is coherently bounded by Chong's 車騎 years. The Wen marshal post is not: claim-476, claim-510, and the first active hint convert Huan Wen's 363–373 tenure into Huizhi's own service span. The source only says he was 大司馬桓溫參軍. Until those three rows use bounds rather than an interval, the person's extracted chronology overstates what the chapter supports.

evidence.quote: 又為車騎桓沖騎兵參軍

personChecks.reason: Huan Wen is present here only as 大司馬桓溫, the title-holder of Huizhi's first staff post. His own office interval AD 363–373 is supported by the 興寧元年 appointment and 寧康元年 death. No birth or death of Wen is claimed from this chapter, and the marshal years are not treated as Huizhi's life dates on Wen's own rows.

Huan Chong is present as 車騎桓沖 and as the superior in s0221's undated rain anecdote. The 375–384 bounds describe uncertainty about his 車騎 title, not activity through a whole dynasty, and they keep the 傳/紀 start conflict. No Chong death is extracted from these units; the 384 end is only an inclusive bound on the title used in this chapter.

findings.problem: Wang Huizhi's undated service as 大司馬桓溫參軍 is encoded as a westernInterval of AD 363–373, and the first active hint repeats “AD 363-373 adviser to Huan Wen.” Those years are Huan Wen's marshal tenure, not demonstrated start and end points of Huizhi's own staff post. The interval therefore states activity throughout Wen's title-years instead of uncertainty about one appointment. The parallel 車騎桓沖 post already uses westernBounds.
findings.action: On claim-476 and claim-510 keep subject, predicate, and office/event wording, but replace westernInterval 363–373 with westernBounds onOrAfter AD 363 and onOrBefore AD 373. Rewrite the first hints-p074 string to the same one-sided bounds language for the Huan Wen staff post; leave the Chong hint unchanged.

references.title: 晉書/卷008 穆帝紀、哀帝紀
references.quote: 冬十月慕容儁寇东阿，遣西中郎将谢万次下蔡，北中郎将郗昙次高平以击之，王师败绩。
references.reason: Primary annals that identify 萬不能用，果敗 with 晉穆帝升平三年冬十月 謝萬's defeat, the conventional AD 359 campaign.

references.title: 晉書/卷008 哀帝紀 興寧元年
references.quote: 五月，加征西大将军桓温侍中、大司马、都督中外诸军事、录尚书事、假黄钺。
references.reason: Primary appointment of Huan Wen as 大司馬 in 晉哀帝興寧元年, the conventional AD 363 start of that title.

references.title: 晉書/卷009 孝武帝紀
references.quote: 秋七月己亥，使持节、侍中、都督中外诸军事、丞相、录尚书、大司马、扬州牧、平北将军、徐兖二州刺史、南郡公桓温薨。
references.reason: Primary death notice that Huan Wen still held 大司馬 in 晉孝武帝寧康元年七月, the conventional AD 373 end of the title.

references.title: 晉書/卷009 孝武帝紀 寧康三年
references.quote: 以中军将军、扬州刺史桓冲为镇北将军、徐州刺史，镇丹徒
references.reason: Annalistic 寧康三年 move that does not yet call Chong 車騎, the competing start against the biography.

references.title: 晉書/卷009 孝武帝紀 太元元年
references.quote: 中军将军桓冲为车骑将军
references.reason: Annalistic 晉孝武帝太元元年 appointment of Chong as 車騎, the later competing start (conventional AD 376).

references.title: 晉書/卷009 孝武帝紀 太元九年
references.quote: 二月辛巳，使持节、都督荆江梁宁益交广七州诸军事、车骑将军、荆州刺史桓冲卒。
references.reason: Primary death of Chong still titled 車騎將軍 in 太元九年二月, the conventional AD 384 inclusive end bound.

references.title: 晉書/卷074 桓沖傳
references.quote: 于是改授都督徐兖豫青扬五州之六郡军事、车骑将军、徐州刺史
references.reason: Biography reading that Chong was already 車騎將軍 at the 甯康三年 (conventional AD 375) Xuanzhou move, preserved rather than discarded.

references.title: 晉書/卷010 安帝紀 隆安三年
references.quote: 十一月甲寅，妖贼孙恩陷会稽，内史王凝之死之
references.reason: Primary passage that dates 孫恩之攻會稽 and Ningzhi's death to 晉安帝隆安三年十一月甲寅.

references.title: 教育部《重編國語辭典》中國歷代年號索引表
references.reason: Year-number index used for conventional AD labels: 升平 357–361, 興寧 363–365, 寧康 373–375, 太元 376–396, 隆安 397–401.

references.reason: Proleptic Gregorian (公曆) new-moon table: 隆安三年十一月朔 is 12-14 癸丑, so 甲寅 remains AD 399 and the year-level conversion does not depend on a Julian default.
